page.title: Settings
page.subtitleWrite: Tracked hotels, scan times, local events, email notifications, users and occupancy data from your PMS
page.subtitleRead: View the tenant's tracked hotels, scan times, notifications, users and PMS data
page.readOnlyNote: View-only account: you can see every setting but can't change anything, except your own message subscriptions on the Notifications tab. Contact your hotel admin if something needs editing.

url.empty: Paste the link to the hotel's page on Booking.com.
url.malformed: That link doesn't look right. Copy the full address from your browser's address bar, starting with https://
url.notBooking: Only Booking.com hotel pages are supported (e.g. https://www.booking.com/hotel/vn/…).

add.title: Add hotel
add.description: Paste the link to the hotel's page on Booking.com. We check the link, then add the hotel to the scan schedule.
add.added: Added “{name}”. We're checking the link; scanning starts right after.

listing.resumeTitle: Resume scanning this hotel on Booking.com
listing.pauseTitle: Pause scanning this Booking.com page (applies to every tenant tracking it)

replaceUrl.label: New Booking.com link for this hotel
replaceUrl.note: The new link replaces the old one; we check it again before scanning.

row.stopTitle: Stop scanning this hotel (you can turn it back on at any time)
row.replaceUrlTitle: Replace the hotel's Booking.com link (broken or pasted by mistake)

list.emptyWrite: Add your own hotel first (role “Your hotel”), then add competitors in the same segment. Each hotel's rooms and rates are read on Booking.com on the scan schedule.
list.emptyRead: Your admin hasn't added any hotels to track yet.
list.title: Watchlist
list.summary: {count, plural, one {# hotel} other {# hotels}}, {active, number} being scanned
list.scanNowTitle: Scan every tracked hotel now, without waiting for the next scheduled time
list.scanStarted: Scanning started. Results appear on Availability in a few minutes.
list.selfEmpty: No hotel of your own yet. Add one with the role “Your hotel” to compare rates with competitors and import PMS data.
list.compEmpty: No competitors yet. Add the hotels in your segment that you usually compare rates with.
list.legend: Green dot: scanning · blue: checking the link · red: broken link · grey: paused. Click “Booking.com” to open the hotel's page.
list.noneReady: No hotel is ready to scan yet.

compset.tierTitle: Only the primary comp set enters the median, listed-rate index and price position; the secondary set (seasonal, aspirational) is still tracked
compset.primaryTitle: Primary comp set: counted in median, price index and price position
compset.secondaryTitle: Secondary comp set: still tracked, not counted in median or price index
compset.compsetOfTitle: Which of your hotels this competitor is compared with; “Shared” = comp set of all your hotels
compset.roomsTitle: Published total room count, used for the fill indicator and the CoStar 50% rule

review.title: Comp set review (CoStar STR standard)
review.ok: Comp set meets the standard: enough competitors, no single hotel dominates.

warn.too_few: The primary comp set has only {count, plural, one {# competitor} other {# competitors}}: at least 4 are needed for a meaningful median and price index.
warn.dominant_hotel: {name} holds {pct}% of comp set rooms (>50%): one hotel dominates the index.
warn.rooms_unknown: {count, plural, one {# competitor has} other {# competitors have}} no room count: enter it to check the 50% rule.
warn.review_due: Comp set last changed {date}; review it at least twice a year.
warn.review_due_never: The comp set has not been reviewed yet; review it at least twice a year.

review.rules: Rules: at least 4 competitors in the primary set, no hotel above 50% of total comp set rooms, review at least twice a year (replace competitors that drift in stars, score or price).

listError.wrongDates: Booking returned a page for different dates than requested (a sign of bot blocking). The scan will retry automatically.
listError.blocked: Booking blocked the list scan; list scanning is paused for a while and will restart automatically.
listError.timeout: Booking responded too slowly for some nights; those nights were skipped and will be scanned next time.
listError.network: Network/proxy error on some nights; those nights were skipped and will be scanned next time.
listError.stuck: The previous scan stopped partway; we rescanned from the first missing night.

config.listNightsHint: One read of the first results page per night, counting hotels with rooms left
config.maxHotelsHint: Top by review count; reads rooms left for each night
config.horizonHint: Up to 90, scanned in tiers like the comp set
config.maxPagesHint: Maximum requests per discovery run (once a day)

add.title: Add market area
add.info: Search by city or district name on Booking.com. A central district (a few hundred hotels) gives more complete figures than a whole city (thousands of properties, including apartments and homestays).
add.searchPlaceholder: e.g. Ho Chi Minh City, District 1, Hanoi Old Quarter
add.noResults: No areas found. Try the English name as used on Booking.com.
add.bigArea: This area has {count, plural, one {# property} other {# properties}}; Booking only shows part of them per scan, so the list is built up over several scans. Consider picking a central district.
add.firstScanHint: The first list scan runs at 03:00, or press “Scan list now” after adding.

area.description: {type} · Booking.com · {count, plural, one {# known hotel} other {# known hotels}}
area.alreadyRunning: A list scan is already running
area.deleteConfirm: Delete the area {name}? Its list scan history will be deleted; hotel data is kept.

market.intro: Scan every hotel in an area on Booking.com: every day at 03:00 we read the results pages for each night (hotels with rooms left, rates, review scores), and at 05:00 we run a detail scan of the most-reviewed hotels to estimate rooms left and occupancy for the whole area. The data appears in Terminal+ and Competitors › Explore the market.
market.emptyBody: Add the city or district where your hotel operates to get market indicators for the whole area.

times.title: Scan times
times.hint: Each time triggers a scan of every tracked hotel, in {timezone}. Up to {max} times.
times.keepOne: Keep at least one scan time

scope.title: Scan range and brief
scope.horizonHint: 1 to 90 nights from today; nights further out are scanned less often
scope.insightHourHint: The daily brief uses the latest scan
scope.languageHint: Language of the AI brief, alert emails and weekly report. The web interface is switched separately with the VI/EN button.
scope.timezoneHint: Scan times and the brief time follow this time zone

schedule.cardDescription: How often rooms are counted each day and when the AI brief is generated

form.name: Event name
form.namePlaceholder: e.g. Ho Chi Minh City Marathon

events.addInfo: Events appear on the Terminal+ calendar next to public holidays. The demand uplift is your own estimate, shared so the whole team sees it; the system doesn't measure it.
events.listDescription: Festivals, conferences, tournaments, travel seasons… that affect room demand around your hotel.
events.emptyBody: Add local events (e.g. F1, fireworks festival, trade fair, peak season) to see them next to market data on the calendar.

sourceMarkets.title: Guest source markets
sourceMarkets.description: Pick the countries your guests usually come from. Their holidays (Lunar New Year, Golden Week, Chuseok…) appear on the Terminal+ and Dashboard calendars and in price suggestions, next to Vietnamese holidays.
sourceMarkets.info: Long holidays in a source market usually lift demand for Vietnam a few days before and during the break. Only the countries you pick are shown.
sourceMarkets.none: No market selected: calendars show Vietnamese holidays only.
sourceMarkets.readOnly: Only the hotel admin can change source markets.

examples.cn: Spring Festival, 1 May, Golden Week 1–7 Oct
examples.au: Spring school break, summer break Dec–Jan

daily_insight.title: Morning brief
daily_insight.describe: Send the AI brief as soon as the daily brief is ready, with links to the evidence.
daily_insight.describeAt: Send the AI brief as soon as the daily brief is ready (around {hour}), with links to the evidence.

weekly_report.title: Weekly report
weekly_report.describe: Monday mornings at 08:00: a summary of competitors over the past 7 days and your next 14 nights.

competitor_sold_out.title: Competitor sold out
competitor_sold_out.describe: When a competitor has just sold out a night within the next <days></days> nights and at least <soldOut></soldOut> competitors are sold out that night.

competitor_low_stock.title: Competitor almost sold out
competitor_low_stock.describe: When a competitor's room type is down to 3 rooms or fewer, for a night within the next <days></days> nights.

competitor_price_drop.title: Competitor rate drop
competitor_price_drop.describe: When a competitor's lowest rate drops by at least <pct></pct> for a night within the next <days></days> nights.

data_stale.title: Stale data
data_stale.describe: When Booking.com data is older than one scan cycle (scans failed or were blocked), so you don't make decisions on stale numbers.

market_tight.title: Tight night
market_tight.describe: When at least <pct></pct> of competitors are sold out or almost sold out (≤3 rooms left) for a night within the next <days></days> nights. Usually a moment to raise rates.

competitor_price_rise.title: Competitor raised rates
competitor_price_rise.describe: When a competitor raises its rate by <pct></pct> or more for the same room type and rate plan, for a night within the next <days></days> nights.

competitor_promo.title: Competitor launched a deep promotion
competitor_promo.describe: When a competitor launches a promotion of <pct></pct> or more off the strikethrough price, for nights within the next <days></days> nights.

own_position_drift.title: Your rate drifted from your target position
own_position_drift.describe: When your listed-price index is more than <pct></pct> away from your target position, for nights within the next <days></days> nights.
own_position_drift.needsStrategy: Off by default. Set a target position in <link>Price strategy</link> before turning it on.

own_closed.title: You are sold out or closed to arrival on Booking.com
own_closed.describe: When your hotel is sold out or not accepting arrivals that day on Booking.com, for a night within the next <days></days> nights.

notifications.emailOff: The email server isn't configured, so OTARadar can't send emails yet. Notifications are still logged under “Recently sent” below.
notifications.emailOffOperator: Set SMTP_HOST, SMTP_FROM (and SMTP_USERNAME, SMTP_PASSWORD) for the jobs worker, then recreate the container.
notifications.emailOffTenant: Contact the OTARadar operations team to turn it on.
notifications.rulesDescription: Alerts are bundled into one message after each scan, only when changes match the conditions below. Applies to every channel.
notifications.invalid: Enter a whole number from {min} to {max}.

recipients.title: Email recipients
recipients.description: Each recipient gets a separate email and can't see the other addresses.
recipients.emptyBody: Add the email of the hotel owner or revenue manager to receive competitor alerts and the morning brief.

test.sent: Test email sent to {count, plural, one {# address} other {# addresses}}. Check the spam folder if it hasn't arrived.

log.title: Recently sent
log.description: Latest {count, plural, one {# notification} other {# notifications}}
log.emptyBody: After the next scan with competitor changes, or when the morning brief is ready, sent messages appear here.

channels.title: Delivery channels
channels.description: Messages go out through the channels that are ready. Each person picks channels under “Subscriptions”.

email.name: Email
email.on: Sent to the recipient list below and to email subscriptions.
email.off: The email server (SMTP) is not configured.

zalo.name: Zalo ZNS
zalo.on: Zalo messages to subscribed phone numbers, about 200–300₫ per delivered message.
zalo.off: Not configured: needs a verified business Official Account and Zalo-approved templates.

webhook.name: Webhook
webhook.on: Posts JSON to each subscription's https URL (Slack, Google Chat, Discord…).

subscriptions.title: Subscriptions
subscriptions.descriptionAdmin: Each person picks channels, message types, quiet hours and a daily cap. You see everyone's subscriptions in this hotel.
subscriptions.descriptionViewer: Choose the channel, message types and quiet hours that suit you. Only you see your subscriptions.
subscriptions.emptyBody: Add your Zalo or email to get the right alerts at the right time.
subscriptions.overLimit: extra ones are bundled into the next
subscriptions.zaloNotReady: Zalo is not configured, so Zalo messages can't be sent yet; the subscription is still saved.

hint.zalo: A number that uses Zalo; messages come from the OTARadar OA.
hint.webhook: https:// only. For Slack, Google Chat, Discord…

form.kindsHint: Pick none to receive every type.
form.quietHint: Messages during quiet hours are bundled into the next one. Leave empty for no quiet hours.

invalid.email: That email doesn't look right, e.g. you@hotel.com.
invalid.phone: That Vietnamese phone number doesn't look right, e.g. 0912 345 678 or +84 912 345 678.
invalid.webhook: The webhook URL must start with https:// and be a valid address.
invalid.quiet: Enter both quiet-hour start and end (HH:MM), or leave both empty.
invalid.quietSame: Quiet-hour start and end must differ.
invalid.maxPerDay: Max messages per day must be a whole number from 1 to 50.

engagement.title: Message engagement
engagement.description: Last {weeks} weeks by channel: did messages arrive, get opened and get handled?
engagement.info: “Clicks” counts people who opened a link in the message. “Handled” counts people who pressed “Handled” in the message or on this page. Cost is the Zalo ZNS fee; email and webhook are free.
engagement.skippedTitle: Not sent because of quiet hours or the daily cap
engagement.emptyBody: Once the first message goes out by email, Zalo or webhook, weekly sends, clicks and handled counts appear here.

roleHint.tenant_admin: Edits the watchlist, scan schedule, users and PMS imports

form.created: Account {email} created. Send the password to the user through a separate channel.

users.addDescription: Admins can change settings; view-only users see figures and briefs.
users.listSummary: {count, plural, one {# account} other {# accounts}}, {active} active
users.emptyWrite: Create accounts for your colleagues above so they can check the rate board every morning.
